content: SSE: This model can converge very fast, for example, 2 or 3 epochs for the SNLI dataset. We control the convergence speed by updating the learning rate for each epoch: specifically, $lr=\frac{1}{2^{\frac{epoch\_i}{2}}}*{init\_lr}$ , where $init\_lr$ is the initial learning rate and $epoch\_i$ is the index of current epoch.
